Judgment Was Delivered Therein As Under:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr Justice N S Sanjay Gowda
 Oral Judgment
1. The claimant is in appeal being dissatisfied with a sum of Rs.1,23,665/- awarded by the Tribunal.
2. The claimant preferred a claim petition under Section 163-A of the Motor Vehicles Act contending that he suffered grievous injuries in the accident which occurred on 11.01.2015.
3. The Tribunal has assessed the disability at 12.5% even though the Neurosurgeon who had treated the claimant had stated that he had 25% permanent neurological disability.

In my view, in the light of the evidence of the treated Neurosurgeon, the assessment of the Tribunal that the claimant had NC: 2024:KHC:50876 suffered only 12.5% disabled to the whole body cannot be accepted.
Consequently, it is held that the claimant had suffered the disability to the extent of 25%.
Consequently, towards 'loss of future income', the claimant would be entitled to a sum of Rs.1,80,000/-.
4. The Tribunal has awarded a sum of Rs.15,000/- towards 'medical expenses'.
The claimant had incurred an expenditure of Rs.59,432/- towards 'medical expenses'.

In my view, the actual medical expenses incurred by the claimant would have to be taken into consideration notwithstanding the stipulation of Rs.15,000/- in the second schedule, since the second schedule was fixed way back in the year 1994.
The remaining sums awarded by the Tribunal is affirmed.
5. A sum of Rs.2,000/- awarded towards conveyance, nourishment and attendant charges by the Tribunal NC: 2024:KHC:50876 is disallowed, as the claim is one under Section 163-A of the Act.
